Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JPM.
Our gross margin expanded by 142 basis points to 57.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $20.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 13% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 26% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $20.9 billion this quarter, representing 13% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
